description: Generate text, images, video, audio, 3D and embeddings through one API at gen.pollinations.ai, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints, hosted MCP servers, a TypeScript SDK and the polli CLI.
rules: Send every API request to https://gen.pollinations.ai; use https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1 as the base URL for OpenAI-compatible SDKs.
Authenticate with the header Authorization: Bearer <key>. Get keys at https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys.
Keep sk_ keys on the server. For browser or mobile apps where users pay, use Connect User Wallets (BRING_YOUR_OWN_POLLEN.md) instead of shipping a key.
List live models with GET https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models or /text/models, /image/models, /audio/models; do not hardcode model names.
Use the hosted MCP server at https://gen.pollinations.ai/mcp/pollinations (Streamable HTTP, Bearer key). The npm package @pollinations/mcp is retired.
Install the MCP servers into coding agents with npx @pollinations/cli mcp install <client>.
